cases.question: How should the joint be supported when removing the clamp?

required_answer_points: Always replace the flexible flat black ring with a new one.
Replace the foam seal on the clamps if it is damaged.
Replace the wear rings if they show extensive wear or damage.

actual.answer: When removing the clamp, the joint must be supported to prevent it from falling off. Support the joint as you remove the second side of the clamp.

cases.question: How should ESD-sensitive parts be handled?

required_answer_points: Hold ESD-sensitive parts by their edges and do not touch their pins or exposed prints.
When handing an ESD-sensitive part to another person, both people must wear ESD wristbands connected to the system ground.
Place the old part in a spare ESD bag before taking the new part out of its ESD bag.

actual.answer: ESD-sensitive parts must be handled by holding them by their edges and not touching their pins or exposed prints. When handing them to another person, both individuals must wear ESD wristbands connected to the system ground. The old part should be placed in a spare ESD bag first, then the new part should be taken from the ESD bag.

cases.question: Which seals and rings should be replaced when assembling a clamp connection?

required_answer_points: Always replace the flexible flat black ring with a new one.
Replace the foam seal on the clamps if it is damaged.
Replace the wear rings if they show extensive wear or damage.

actual.answer: When assembling a clamp connection, the flexible flat black ring, the foam seal on the clamps (if damaged), and the wear rings (if extensive wear or damage is shown) must be replaced.

accepted_evidence.text:
Assembling Clamp Connection

Clamp The assembly is done in reverse of the disassembly. However, a few things must be noted
assembly before assembly is begun.

NOTICE

• Always replace the flexible flat black ring with a new one to maintain the
IP classification.
• Replace the foam seal on the clamps, if damaged, to maintain the IP
classification.
• Replace the wear rings if extensive wear or damage is shown.
• The dots must be aligned; otherwise, the connection cannot be made.

CAUTION

• Joints should be assembled in a vertical position to ensure proper
mating between the joints.

cases.question: How is the blue lid removed before disassembling a clamp connection?

required_answer_points: Remove the screws in the blue lid.
Then remove the blue lid before continuing with the clamp connection disassembly.

actual.answer: To remove the blue lid before disassembling a clamp connection, you must remove the screws in the blue lid, then remove the blue lid as shown in section General Guidance to Separate Joint from Counterpart.

Screw 1. Remove the screws in the blue lid, then remove the blue lid as shown in section
